why: From A to B the small shape (circle) becomes the big outline, and the big black shape (triangle) becomes small, turns upside down and sits inside at the top. Doing the same to C: the small square becomes the big outline, and the black up-arrow becomes a small down-arrow at the top inside it. That is option 4. Option 2 has the arrow inside a square too, but it still points up.
trick: Watch for size swap: big becomes small and small becomes big. Then check if the small one also turned upside down.
